evals.prompt: Build a one-page complement to https://prommer.net/en/tech/press/ for podcast producers: five angles (title, outlet, date, link, one restating sentence), proof numbers with an as-of date and a source link each, a download-as-.md button. Link to the press page for bios, headshots and contact; do not copy them. Keep noindex and the unofficial footer. build.mjs reads facts.json and fails while any question marker remains. Check 390px. Deploy to GitHub Pages; the public URL must return 200.
evals.expected_output: A static index.html built from facts.json, deployed publicly, with five sourced angles, sourced proof numbers, a working .md download, noindex, the exact unofficial footer and no placeholder text.
expectations: index.html shows exactly five angles, and each has a title, outlet, date, link and one restating sentence that matches a kind=angle entry in facts.json with the same source URL.
Every proof number on the page sits under an 'as of' date and has its own source link, and each value matches a kind=number entry in facts.json that has a source URL and an evidence snippet.

No unfilled placeholder ships: index.html contains no {{HUMAN marker and no <question N> text, and running node build.mjs against a copy of facts.json that contains a {{HUMAN: question 1}} marker exits non-zero without writing index.html.

index.html has a robots meta tag containing noindex, a visible footer with the exact text 'Concept built for an application. Not an official prommer.net page.', and links to https://prommer.net/en/tech/press/ for bios, headshots and the contact form without copying bio text or headshot images.

At a 390px viewport the page has no horizontal scroll, and the Download as .md button is reachable by keyboard and downloads a .md file containing the five angles and the proof numbers (see verify/check.mjs and its results file).
The public GitHub Pages URL returns HTTP 200 on a clean curl and serves the same index.html as the repo.
